name: Atari 7800 ProSystem
significance: One of the earliest consoles to feature full backward compatibility with its predecessor's software library (Atari 2600).

editorialContent.overview: Atari's backwards-compatible 8-bit platform featuring impressive on-screen sprite counts powered by the MARIA chip.
